notice: This is a checksum-bound execution specification, not a transformation run, source admission, ingestion receipt, release approval, or production claim. common.outputSidecar: canonical JSON manifest containing this specification id, input and output SHA-256, byte lengths, exact archive version IDs, source and output feature counts, schema fingerprint, CRS, geometry QA, exclusions, tool versions, UTC execution timestamps, and every validation result
common.archiveRule: Read exact named object versions only; never overwrite, replace, or treat a later mutable source response as the bound input.
common.admissionRule: Transformation, ingestion, public release, and production admission are four separate recorded decisions. A successful run cannot imply any of them.
common.qaRule: Fail closed on checksum, archive-version, schema, feature-count, identifier, CRS, geometry, or sidecar mismatch. Preserve raw input and write a failure receipt without an output release.
